suggestions.reason: Assertions 1 and 2 bundle three independent conditions (literal status token / reason fetch_failed present / no 无竞品-class wording) into one pass-fail. This run satisfied the second and third fully and failed only on the token (NOT_ESTABLISHED + UNVERIFIED + 「未核验」 instead of 「未能核实」). If the intent is to detect that the new skill's canonical token lands, say so explicitly in the assertion text so graders are not tempted to accept synonyms; if the intent is behavioral, split into three assertions so the AB can tell which condition the baseline misses.

suggestions.assertion: 两个情形都明确: 探针结果不阻断本轮、不改变 verdict、不改变收敛判定 (advisory, fail-closed 只作用于措辞)
suggestions.reason: The parenthetical 'fail-closed 只作用于措辞' leaves a gray zone: this answer keeps the probe out of verdict/convergence mechanically but recommends the challenge group raise an objection against any decision whose rationale depends on 'no sibling spec' (response.md:65). That is a content-level effect beyond wording. State whether such downstream objections are permitted so the verdict on this assertion is deterministic (I passed it).

No assertion checks that the unverified state is carried forward to the final report and not silently upgraded in later rounds. This answer does it (response.md:62 '不得在末轮悄悄升格为 established', line 140), but a wrong answer that writes 「未能核实」 in Round 1 and then drops the caveat from the final verdict section would pass all four assertions.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions 3 and 4 are discriminating and were genuinely met. Assertions 1 and 2 are purely lexical: the answer's semantics match the intended fail-closed rendering exactly, and it fails only for not emitting the four characters 「未能核实」, which is by design for detecting whether the skill prescribes the canonical token.
